property_summary: For any owner call to sendTo with amount == 0, the call must revert with EMPTY revert data (the require(amount>0) check fires before any external transfer); the mutant performs the low-level transfer first, so a zero-amount transfer to a rejecting receiver bubbles the receiver's non-empty revert data.
change_summary: Move require(amount > 0) to after the transfer, so a zero-amount transfer is executed before the require reverts, exposing different observable outcomes (revert vs success) for amount == 0.
